architecture.capacity: 32 current-coordinator resident context RPC requests, covering input collection, parsed arguments, submitted and active workers; this is not a claim about 250 workflow tasks/models.
architecture.executor: Dedicated 32 workers; no default/global executor submissions. HTTP admission rejects before reading body or submitting work. Worker completion callback releases occupancy even if HTTP handler was cancelled; outer ASGI lifespan joins all physical workers.
architecture.deadline: One monotonic 30-second default start deadline from HTTP handler entry includes body/executor/lease delays. Lock arbitrates begin against expiration/disconnect. Started operations finish with existing durable unknown/closure semantics and never receive not_started due to deadline.
architecture.memory: At most32 admitted request bodies, each262144 bytes before decode; at most16 metadata contexts with existing LRU/source bounds. ASGI/network transport buffers and response transmission are outside this input-residency bound; no RSS assertion.
architecture.authority: Live installation/token/mandate/task/remote assignment checks before lease, every50ms while waiting, and existing per-operation and completed checks; no permission cache.
architecture.transport: ContextNotStarted subclasses HTTPError only for exact503 JSON detail status not_started/reason context_capacity. No automatic retries. Unknown and all other responses preserve failure semantics.
